description: The provider obtains images of one breast by applying an external magnetic field and radiofrequency waves to create three–dimensional images with and without contrast; he may also perform real–time computer–aided detection (CAD).

77048, Description = Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), breast, including computer-aided detection (CAD), without and with contrast material(s), when performed; unilateral. 77048, ICD-10- CM Code = See tables 2a and 2b. | 77048 §, 77049 §, Description = Magnetic resonance imaging, breast, without and with contrast material

expected_checklist:

- Check timing since prior screening or interval requirement.
- Check relevant family history, BRCA status, or high-risk criteria.
- Check that the procedure is tied to the required screening/add-on context.

user_query: Does Medi-Cal cover a diagnostic mammogram for one breast?
title: Diagnostic mammogram, one breast
description: The provider performs X–ray imaging on one breast in a patient with a known lump or suspected cancer and may use specially designed computer software to help identify or diagnose potential abnormalities within the images; the software converts signals into digital data and analyzes the images.
policy_context:
## Table of CPT Codes for Diagnostic Mammography
77065, Description = Diagnostic mammography, including computer-aided detection when performed; unilateral. CPT codes 77065 and 77066 are limited to two screenings per year. | ## Mammography With Xeroradiography
Providers must use CPT codes 77065 for unilateral diagnostic mammography and 77066 for bilateral diagnostic mammography whether or not xeroradiography was used in the examination. CPT codes 77065 and 77066 may be billed with modifiers U7 or 99 as appropriate and cannot both be billed on the same day for the same recipient.
expected_checklist:
- Check symptoms or abnormal clinical findings.
- Check provider order, referral, or medical necessity indication.
- Check laterality (left, right, unilateral, bilateral, one/both breasts).

description: The provider performs X–ray imaging on one breast in a patient with a known lump or suspected cancer and may use specially designed computer software to help identify or diagnose potential abnormalities within the images; the software converts signals into digital data and analyzes the images.
policy_context:
## Table of CPT Codes for Diagnostic Mammography
77065, Description = Diagnostic mammography, including computer-aided detection when performed; unilateral. CPT codes 77065 and 77066 are limited to two screenings per year. | ## Mammography With Xeroradiography
Providers must use CPT codes 77065 for unilateral diagnostic mammography and 77066 for bilateral diagnostic mammography whether or not xeroradiography was used in the examination. CPT codes 77065 and 77066 may be billed with modifiers U7 or 99 as appropriate and cannot both be billed on the same day for the same recipient.
expected_checklist:
- Check symptoms or abnormal clinical findings.
- Check provider order, referral, or medical necessity indication.
- Check laterality (left, right, unilateral, bilateral, one/both breasts).

description: The provider performs X–ray imaging on one breast in a patient with a known lump or suspected cancer and may use specially designed computer software to help identify or diagnose potential abnormalities within the images; the software converts signals into digital data and analyzes the images.
policy_context:
## Table of CPT Codes for Diagnostic Mammography
77065, Description = Diagnostic mammography, including computer-aided detection when performed; unilateral. CPT codes 77065 and 77066 are limited to two screenings per year. | ## Mammography With Xeroradiography
Providers must use CPT codes 77065 for unilateral diagnostic mammography and 77066 for bilateral diagnostic mammography whether or not xeroradiography was used in the examination. CPT codes 77065 and 77066 may be billed with modifiers U7 or 99 as appropriate and cannot both be billed on the same day for the same recipient.
expected_checklist:
- Check symptoms or abnormal clinical findings.
- Check provider order, referral, or medical necessity indication.
- Check laterality (left, right, unilateral, bilateral, one/both breasts).

description: The provider performs X–ray imaging on both breasts in a patient with a lump or suspected cancer and may use specially designed computer software to help identify or diagnose potential abnormalities within the images; the software converts signals into digital data and analyzes the images.
policy_context:
77066, Description = Diagnostic mammography, including computer-aided detection when performed; bilateral
Diagnostic mammography is reimbursable if one of the following applies:
- The recipient has distinct signs and symptoms for which a mammogram is indicated; or
- The recipient has a history of breast cancer; or
- The recipient is asymptomatic, but on the basis of the recipient's history and oth | ## Mammography With Xeroradiography
Providers must use CPT codes 77065 for unilateral diagnostic mammography and 77066 for bilateral diagnostic mammography whether or not xeroradiography was used in the examination. CPT codes 77065 and 77066 may be billed with modifiers U7 or 99 as appropriate and cannot both be billed on the same day for the same recipient.
expected_checklist:
- Check symptoms or abnormal clinical findings.
- Check provider order, referral, or medical necessity indication.
- Check laterality (left, right, unilateral, bilateral, one/both breasts).

An explanation of code 77067 is placed in the Description field (Box 43).››
Enter the two-digit facility type code '72' (clinic - hospital based | ## Screening Mammography
Screening mammography must be billed with CPT code 77067 (screening mammography, bilateral [2-view study of each breast], including computer-aided detection when performed). CPT code 77067 may be billed with modifiers U7 or 99 as appropriate.
